<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Moro conflict]]
**A suspected [[improvised explosive device]] planted by the [[Bangsamoro Islamic Freedom Fighters]] [[2018 Isulan bombing|explodes]] at a town festival in [[Isulan]], [[Sultan Kudarat]], [[Philippines]], killing two people and injuring 35 others. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/210614-sultan-kudarat-explosion-august-28-2018 (Rappler)]
**A Catholic priest held hostage for almost four months by Muslim militants in Marawi city in the southern Philippines says he still believes in inter-religious dialogue despite experiencing horrors that included seeing a fellow captive gunned down in crossfire and another one killed during an airstrike. [https://www.benarnews.org/english/news/philippine/Priest-Marawi-08292018151129.html (BenarNews)]

;Arts and culture
*The [[European Space Agency]] (ESA) unveils two titanium plaques etched with artwork, which will be part of the outside of the [[CHEOPS]] [[exoplanet]]-[[characterization (materials science)|characterization]] satellite during its orbit around [[Earth]]. [https://phys.org/news/2018-08-artwork-unveiled-exoplanet-satellite.amp (Phys.org)]

;Business and economy
*Irish paper production and packaging firm [[Smurfit Kappa]] release a statement explaining that one of its production facilities was seized a week earlier on August 21 by the [[Venezuela]]n government and its managers were arrested, with the company accused of not setting their prices at government-approved levels and smuggling. It says that the government have taken over operation of the plant. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-45343310 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Hurricane Maria death toll controversy]]
**A study from the [[Milken Institute School of Public Health]] finds that a total of 2,975 people died in [[Puerto Rico]] due to [[Hurricane Maria]], bringing the official death toll up from 64. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/death-toll-hurricane-maria-3000-puerto-rico-study/story?id=57179291 (ABC News)]
*Seven states in [[Venezuela]] are affected as the [[Orinoco River]] floods. [https://www.voanoticias.com/a/venezuela-inundaciones-ayuda-reporta-alvaro-algarra-/4547865.html (Voice of America)]

;Health and environment
*[[Water supply and sanitation in Iraq]]
**Health officials state that the [[Iraq]]i city of [[Basra]] has recorded 17,000 infection cases due to water contamination. A [[Cholera outbreaks and pandemics|cholera outbreak]] is feared as salinity rates continue to increase in the unprocessed water. [https://amp.iraqinews.com/features/iraqs-basra-declares-17000-infection-cases-from-water-pollution/ (Iraqi News)]
*[[Phase-out of lightweight plastic bags]]
**[[Anchorage, Alaska|Anchorage]], [[Alaska]], passes a strict ban on [[plastic shopping bag]]s, and imposes a fee on the use of store-issued paper bags. The law goes into effect on March 1, 2019. [https://www.adn.com/alaska-news/anchorage/2018/08/28/anchorage-approves-strict-plastic-bag-ban-fees-for-paper-bags/?outputType=amp-type (''Anchorage Daily News'')]

;International relations
*[[Bolivarian diaspora]]
**The Brazilian government sends armed forces to be stationed along its [[Brazil-Venezuela border|Venezuelan border]] for two weeks, due to a large increase in migrants from [[Venezuela]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-45338769 (BBC)]
**[[Peru]] declares a 60-day public health crisis in its northern provinces, with concern of the [[Venezuela]]n migrants spreading diseases. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-45338769 (BBC)], [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-08-30/venezuela-s-neighbors-join-to-contain-crushing-flow-of-refugees (Bloomberg)]

;Law and crime
*Former [[Texas State Police|Texas police officer]] Roy Oliver is found guilty in the murder of 15-year old [[Mesquite High School (Texas)|Mesquite High School]] freshman [[Shooting of Jordan Edwards|Jordan Edwards]]. [https://na01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nbcnews.com%2Fnews%2Fus-news%2Fex-texas-police-officer-roy-oliver-found-guilty-murder-shooting-n904166&amp;data=02%7C01%7CMark.Marji%40uky.edu%7Cbdc6b811c47448cbdd3708d60db7a516%7C2b30530b69b64457b818481cb53d42ae%7C0%7C0%7C636711479732626845&amp;sdata=hJtaWXIkqvyk6Gt6BsQn4Eg7YQmf85rYgMvllp0AbwU%3D&amp;reserved=0 (NBC News)] [https://na01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fstarlocalmedia.com%2Fmesquitenews%2Fnews%2Fex-balch-springs-officer-found-guilty-of-murdering-mesquite-teen%2Farticle_ac4a6cf6-aa48-11e8-81b6-f7ba92685574.html&amp;data=02%7C01%7CMark.Marji%40uky.edu%7Cbdc6b811c47448cbdd3708d60db7a516%7C2b30530b69b64457b818481cb53d42ae%7C0%7C0%7C636711479732626845&amp;sdata=uOKZbxInbFvUaNcSNN4BtlVrdvTZPSazPpXv74Wzje8%3D&amp;reserved=0 (Star Local Media)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of France]]
**[[Nicolas Hulot]] resigns as [[Ministry of Ecology|Minister of Ecology]] during a live interview on [[France Inter]] radio, citing [[French President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]]'s record on environmental issues and his own frustration over feeling alone in prioritizing reform. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/nicolas-hulot-quits-france-emmanuel-macron-environment-resigns-green-a8510606.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[Politics of Iran]]
**The [[Parliament of Iran]] questions [[President of Iran|President]] [[Hassan Rouhani]] on weak economic growth, banking restrictions and rising prices. It is not satisfied by four of his five answers and refers the case to [[Judiciary of Iran|the judiciary]]. He chiefly blames the [[United States sanctions against Iran|United States' sanctions]], and vows the "plot" will not succeed. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-economy-rouhani-sanctions/irans-parliament-blames-rouhani-for-economic-troubles-refers-him-to-judiciary-idUSKCN1LD0DD (Reuters)] [http://www.tehrantimes.com/news/426937/Rouhani-in-parliament-answers-questions-by-MPs (''Tehran Times''}]

;Science and technology
*The world's first [[Robo-Taxi|autonomous taxi]] service begins operating in [[Tokyo]], [[Japan]]. The pilot project will run until September 8, with full commercial operations expected to start in 2020, when the city hosts the [[2020 Summer Olympics]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2018/aug/28/driverless-taxi-debuts-in-tokyo-in-world-first-trial-ahead-of-olympics (''The Guardian'')] [http://www.reuters.tv/v/Ppkf/2018/08/27/japan-trials-robot-taxi-ahead-of-2020-olympics (Reuters)]
*For the first time, scientists observe the [[Higgs Boson]] decay into [[bottom quark]]s. This supports a prediction in the [[Standard Model]] of particle physics. [https://phys.org/news/2018-08-long-sought-higgs-boson.html (Phys.org)]
